page_title: PAR 2-2 ACM | Parma v AC Milan 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' The linesman signals that Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90+4' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
90+2' It's time for a substitution. Benjamin Cremaschi (Parma) comes on in place of Patrick Cutrone.

90+1' Luka Modric (AC Milan) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Zion Suzuki was alert and the score remains the same.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

89' Mariano Troilo (Parma) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Marco Di Bello with no other option than to blow for a foul. AC Milan are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
87' Substitution. Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) has come on for Koni De Winter.
87' Luka Modric (AC Milan) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
86' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
83' The game is interrupted now, Zion Suzuki (Parma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

82' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
81' Carlos Cuesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hernani (Parma) replacing Adrian Bernabe Garcia.
78' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) will deliver the corner kick.
76' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
73' AC Milan seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

72' The game is interrupted. Koni De Winter (AC Milan) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a free kick to Parma in a dangerous position.
71' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
71' A substitution has been made. Samuele Ricci goes off and Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) comes on.
70' The substitution is prepared. Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pervis Estupinan.
70' Luka Modric (AC Milan) earns the yellow card.
68' Carlos Cuesta has decided to substitute Mathias Lovik and he is replaced by Emanuele Valeri (Parma).
66' Luka Modric (AC Milan) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
65' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. AC Milan earn a corner.
62' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Enrico Del Prato (Parma) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 2:2.
62' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) received a precise low pass and attempted to surprise the keeper with a snap shot, but his beautiful shot smashed against the right post!
60' Substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) replaces Christopher Nkunku.

58' Close! Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
54' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is about to take a corner kick.
53' Wow, what an escape. Enrico Del Prato (Parma) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Parma have a corner.
52' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The AC Milan players are visibly unhappy with the call.
51' Referee Marco Di Bello makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Parma. Let’s see what happens!
50' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from AC Milan for a penalty. Play continues.
49' Great teamplay by AC Milan as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' Substitution. Mariano Troilo (Parma) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Abdoulaye Ndiaye walks off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' 1 - 2 Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) controls the ball with an excellent first touch on the edge of the penalty box after receiving a splendid pass and smashes the ball into the top right corner!
45+1' Luka Modric (AC Milan) takes the corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

45' Zion Suzuki makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of inside the right post. AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
45' Luka Modric (AC Milan) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
42' Wonderful movement by AC Milan. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
40' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Sascha Britschgi (Parma).
39' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) stoops for a header low near the left post from a cross, but the goalkeeper pulls off a great save!
38' It's a nice effort by Luka Modric (AC Milan) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Zion Suzuki. Easy save.
36' Parma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
33' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
32' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Di Bello blows for a foul. AC Milan win a free kick.
31' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
29' Now Parma have a corner.
25' 0 - 2 Goal! Zion Suzuki gets a hand on the penalty from Rafael Leao (AC Milan), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
25' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is going to take the penalty!
25' Referee Marco Di Bello is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to AC Milan!
22' Celebrations by AC Milan are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.

22' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle after Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. AC Milan are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
19' The foul by Patrick Cutrone (Parma) was seen by Marco Di Bello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. AC Milan win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
18' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) has a goal ruled out for offside!
17' Parma get a corner.
15' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Parma.
15' Referee Marco Di Bello signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the AC Milan players have a reason to celebrate!
14' The goal for AC Milan is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.

12' 0 - 1 Goal! Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) neatly controls a decent pass from Christopher Nkunku. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom left corner from the edge of the box. 0:1.

12' Parma slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
9' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

8' Christopher Nkunku almost found himself in a promising position after Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
6' Parma enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' A pass from Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) is intercepted by Zion Suzuki and the move breaks down.
3' Luka Modric (AC Milan) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
2' AC Milan seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Parma will have the kick-off.
Marco Di Bello got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
